name: Jinx
description: Voice set for T1 Jinx (skin 62): a championship-winning carry performance. Esports final energy: draft, scrims, bot lane, clutch plays, trophies and a roaring crowd. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a bad round, that's a full wipe! Everybody regroup, we're clutching this!
Down {voteDiff}? Their draft read ours. Fine. Time for the pick they'll never ban!
{voteDiff} behind! Strategy says play safe. I say carry and hope the team follows!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The crowd's quiet and my hands are loud. Go, go, go!
Only {voteDiff} behind. One good fight and we're back in the game!
Down {voteDiff}. Slow early game, that's all. Go vote and we'll scale!
Dead even! Game five, final minute, nexus on the line. Somebody make the call!
One vote apart! One! The whole title rides on a single click!
{voteDiff} votes apart! My palms are sweating on the keyboard! Stay calm, team!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a perfect clutch or a historic throw. I'm warmed up for both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a win, that's a clean sweep! Raise the trophy!
{userPct}%! The arena's chanting! Take a bow before the next game!
{userPct}% and rising! Lead's growing. Don't misplay now!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Nobody say 'easy game'. That's how you lose the next fight!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just reversed the whole series! Nobody calls that in draft!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Down but never out. That's a championship run!
Clawed back from {voteDiff} behind! Not pretty, absolutely effective!
{momentTitle} just took the lead mid-teamfight. Quiet, clean, and the crowd's on its feet!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A teammate! Stay in your lane, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Same draft! I call dibs on carry.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the squad. Don't leak the strategy!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two players! The other team doesn't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two carries, one lane. Share it or flame!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Log it in the scrim notes, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny roster! The scene's slightly louder!
{username} has game sense and it matches yours. Good reads, both of you!
details: Roster's growing! I'm still on carry.
Look at you, playing as a team!
Don't tell the other teams I enjoy this.
A new friend! I'll save them a good lane.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before the timer runs out!
I give it a week before you argue over who gets the kills.
New sub! I'm drawing a logo on your badge.
More players, more wins, I mean votes!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival team in my lane! Lock in!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A trash-talker! With stats!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just reviewing the tape. With menace.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry on the bracket-rival list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper best-of-five!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is the better pick. A rival squad! Let's see who tilts first.
{username} voted against you. Two teams, one stage. Somebody's going home early!
{username} versus you! I'm taking the best seat, snacks, and the big ultimate.
details: I'm not saying trash talk. I'm saying the replay's clear.
The big ultimate wants a word. It's been on cooldown a while.
They'll learn. Worlds is a slow teacher with a loud crowd.
One stage, two teams. Somebody's getting out-drafted.
I like them already. They play with heart.
I don't care. Check the standings. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the scrims spicy!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two play like one roster! A loud one!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either synergy or you share a gaming chair. Cute!
Ten straight with {username}! The whole team's talking about it. By team I mean me.
{streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary duo! I'm sniffling. It's stage smoke!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect synergy, every time. I'd write a highlight reel but I'd miss the best bit.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a trophy.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop shouting callouts!
Is this healthy? Ask the team doctor. He's on a break!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep meeting in the same bracket!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a rivalry arc!
Ten series against {username}. I'm selling front-row seats.
details: This is the grand final now.
The whole arena wants a ticket.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a proper rivalry! I LOVE rivalries!
{streakCount} series with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Queue up!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole world tour.
details: Bigger than our last final. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit tilted.
One of you has to run out of energy drinks. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The draft timer's running, player!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the lobby! Don't leave the team waiting!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it between teamfights.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The shot-clock's blaring, player! That's a warning!
Beep, beep, beep! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the objective!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still in champ select. Lock in!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last fight! Lock in, then click!
{timeLeft}! That's the last objective on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Final play on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop checking your stats and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to end their series and you haven't voted in any of them! First one's over in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all running out of clock. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty arena! Somebody has to cheer first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the casters are speechless!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to make the first play. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first fan. I've got a headset. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The emptiest stand in the whole arena!
Hardly anyone's wandered over here. What's wrong with the broadcast?
Low turnout. I blame the lag. And you. Equally. With stats.
Barely any votes here. Somebody queue up more spectators!
details: Go on, give it a watch.
It deserves a fuller stand. So do I.
Make some noise, wave a banner!
Don't be shy. Shy is for the substitute bench. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the series. Funny, I know someone who hasn't played. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two teams, equal score. I'm looking at you, player. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You're the last player on the map!
{moment1} and {moment2}, both in the final, and you've been quiet in the stands. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the clock's nearly out! Last chance to play!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only player who can break it!
Still tied with the timer at zero. Pick a team! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Headsets on, hands warm! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new bracket to judge!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting in the lobby. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the favourites!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Clean finish! Called it!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a proper fight.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the team doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great tournament. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are eliminated teams. Very respectfully eliminated.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy the replay!
details: Your pick's still in the tournament!
One series down, lots of bracket left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Tenser!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A bad teamfight. I'll sulk about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a replay of the throw.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll clap one slow clap in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too fast for this bracket anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the arena went quiet. I hate a quiet arena. Somebody make some noise!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A tilted bit.
details: They'll pay for this. In scrims.
It was good. The whole arena knows.
You'll find another team. Good players always come back.
Every tournament ends. That's what makes the next one fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still in champ select? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll warm up!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the draft screen?
They're all great picks! Pick one! Lock in first, doubt later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at a champion, and hope.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a meta way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking costs games.
Trust your reads. Mine are mostly instinct and caffeine.

messages: New player! Welcome! {liveCount} matches on the schedule and every one's a final!
{liveCount} edits battling it out on stage and you just wandered in. Pick a team before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Headset's on, hands are warm, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No scripts, {liveCount} live matches, and me at the carry spot. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I kept your seat warm. Okay, I put my headset on it. But I kept it.
Two days running! Look at you, a scrim regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other teams.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your seat got cold!
You're back after {days} days! The tournament kept going without you. Mostly teamfights.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your chair felt empty. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The arena was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another series?
You came back! Let's go win something. Loudly.
Your first vote! A tiny play. The first game is always the most nervous.
One down. The roster's got a new player. You!
Five already? You're staying for the whole series! Most players quit after game one.
Five votes! The hands are warm.
details: Not just a spectator after all. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular on my team now. Sit anywhere. Not there, that's the captain's chair.
Ten votes. That's a proper little scrim block.
details: A regular on the roster. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole arena knows your name.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a crowd at match point.
details: The arena knows your name. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly on the main stage now.
Fifty! Past the lobby, past the green room, right under the lights.
A hundred votes! Okay, that's a tournament legend. Confetti for everyone!
One hundred! They'll show the highlight reel of this. Mostly the lucky bits. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The practice room's still lit.
Three days in a row! You've got the routine.
details: The practice room stays lit. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You show up for practice even without a match. My kind of player!
Seven days straight! That's discipline. Boring. Impressive!
Two weeks! Not even a bad patch could stop you!
Fourteen days! Even the coach takes a nap by now.
details: Not even a losing streak slowed you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my keyboards!
A whole month of grinding. Give yourself a medal. I've got a plastic one.
details: A month in the practice room. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You go against the meta like a surprise pick in the final draft!
Five long shots! The stats say no. Your gut says yes.
Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow the meta either. We should talk. Not about meta.
Fifteen picks nobody drafted! A true off-meta player.
Thirty underdogs! A dark horse in the final bracket if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I'm on the other side of the screen.
details: A dark horse in the bracket. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always reach the lobby before the countdown does.
Five early votes! Fast hands!
details: Fastest hands in the lobby. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you picked first! Not a player, an analyst!
Fifteen early ones! You call the winner before the whole arena does.
details: Analysing ahead of the crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones! Hands on the keyboard every time!
Ten buzzer-beaters. You live for the final tick of the clock, don't you?
details: Close ones suit a clutch player. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the final play follows!
Your vote lands on the nexus. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a team down three games.
You don't give up on a squad because they're behind. I love that.
details: Faith in the reverse sweep. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! You've found your favourite champion!
That one again? Yeah. It's got good synergy.
Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a fan to a favourite team.
Okay, you've adopted it. No swapping.
details: Loyal to the final whistle. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a one-trick!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the team. I am the team.
Two rounds in! You see the whole tournament through, even without a seat!
Round two reached! Still playing!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the bracket now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like pressure.
details: Four rounds into the knockout. +{xp} XP

messages: All the way to round six! You saw the whole tournament through!
Six rounds! You never left the arena! Wow!
Ten matches! You're checking out every game!
Ten different matches! Curious analyst, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every lobby, every broadcast, every backroom!
Twenty-five! You really do watch everything.
Fifty matches! That's not scouting, that's a whole season of tournaments!
Fifty matches! You know this bracket better than I do.
details: A full season of games. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting! Can't leave the chair, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the hands warm!
details: Five games in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one go! Take a breath! Stretch your wrists!
Ten matches without leaving the chair! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Late-night scrims are the best scrims.
Middle of the night! That's when the real grinding happens.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Hype across the whole server!
Five shares! You're calling in the fans! Good!
details: Thanks for rallying the fans. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically the team's marketing department!
Fifteen! You keep telling every spectator.
You were here before the crowd! Founding player! Yours forever!
One of the first through the arena doors! That counts, you know!
details: Yours forever, trophy and all. +{xp} XP
Nobody can ban that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! A shiny new badge on the jersey!
Promoted! A bigger badge, a louder crowd. Don't let it go to your head!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Something's gone off! In a clutch way!
Another one: {name}! Clean, cold, championship!
{rank}! Bigger arena, brighter lights!
Mastery up! Now the tournament gets properly serious.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a carry performance worth cheering!
Ten long shots! Chaos in the lobby. Brilliant results too.
details: A loose cannon with clutch reads. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll high-five her. Once.
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I high-fived!
details: Ten close calls, ten wins. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love a strict practice schedule!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than the final boss!
details: A week at the sheriff's practice table. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Clean finish! Boom!
A tied match and you took the play! Nice!
details: The vote that took the series. +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the champion in the finals? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
T1 Jinx! Don't ask about the strategy. Do ask about the trophy.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm still warming up my hands. Check back soon?
Shh! The draft's about to start. I can feel it in my fingertips.
Lobby's locked for now. Doesn't stop me planning the picks.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, finals never are.
Watch both. Then pick the one that gives you goosebumps.
I won't tell the other teams who you picked. Probably. The broadcast might.
Take your time, player! Actually, don't. The draft clock's ticking.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the casters are. A little.
Pick the one you'd replay ten times in the highlight reel. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's in the lobby yet. Be the first player, I dare you!
Empty arena! Make some noise with a vote.
Not one fan in the stands! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still in champ select. Pick something!
The match clock's nearly out. Don't make me call the countdown. I will, on the headset.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Lock in before the draft ends!
Beep, beep, tilt. That's the last of the game time draining.
closing-final: Last fight! Click now, analyse later!
Any second now. Seriously. Hit lock-in!
voted-early: One of the first in the lobby! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's in the stands and you picked a team anyway. Respect, player!
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the crowd favourite! Don't get comfy, upsets happen.
{pct}% with you! Great reads. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole arena's cheering with you for once. Odd!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Keep your hands steady!
Ahead, for now. Metas shift. So do crowds.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm peeking through my fingers at the scoreboard!
A tower apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the whole server!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and every fan you know.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's overheating and it's my keyboard. Possibly me.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody tense!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the bracket.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't tilt in the lobby. I'd tilt, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog squad! My favourite kind!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the fight!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the server. Loudly. Make some noise!
Everyone's picking the other team. Cool! Be the surprise.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a coach's eye.
A win! A sneaky little comeback of a victory. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the series!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it tilt, then queue the next one!
Didn't make it. I've lost bigger finals. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll watch the replay in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to crack first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Series is over. You missed this one! There's always another tournament.
All done here. {winner} took the title. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first play! The scary one. Now you're on the roster. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the replay.
You're a player now. Try not to throw the lead!
streak: Again? You keep queuing up! I'm not complaining. I saved your seat.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm logging your scrims.
Back again! Good teams keep their players. Stay!
underdog: Backing the team nobody's watching? Ooh. I see you, player.
Bold! Everyone else is behind the favourites. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of player. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to set the pace before the crowd arrives. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the carrying.
First one into the arena! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just swung the series! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Pixel-thin! One more fan and the whole bracket flips.
Close one! Your click tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't eliminated. Go fetch your teammates!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a play to make.
Behind, but the game's still on. Not even close to over!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Series swing fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or with a roar. I don't mind.
Look at that! Clean read. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your pick. Not yet.
Done! That one's on you now, player.
Your vote's in. Go and see what else is on the schedule!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't locked in a single one! Start with whichever one hypes you.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not warming up.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little tilt!
live-some: You're in the flow now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't lock themselves in.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole day's games!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the day's done.
live-one: One left! Just one! Lock it in!
Last one! Don't leave it to the timer!
One match between you and the trophy lift!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Move, player!
The clocks are loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of game time! Pick, quick!
live-done: Your whole schedule's locked in! Look at you! On to the bracket!
Nothing left on your schedule. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare for a player. Thanks!
live-none: No games live right now. They'll relaunch! Go and peek at the bracket.
Empty arena. A bit too empty. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already. Might watch old replays.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, pack the bags!
Everyone starts in a pool. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They change faster than the meta!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group move on to the stage.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish their games first!
Patience! The knockout unlocks once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're sent home!
Single elimination! No resets. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your coach.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're out of the tournament!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round, like a funnel to the final!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, a schedule.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for being in the stands!
It's over! Good tournament! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell the team.
That's the champion! The whole run, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nobody's been seeded. Give it a moment.
Empty! Nobody's been seeded yet. Soon!
Nothing on the schedule yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no rematches. Take a seat in the arena on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting it out! {a} versus {b}. Come and call the series.
{a} versus {b} and the whole team can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I locked in {pick} over {other}. Come tell me my draft's off!
{pick} got my click. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, call me out.
early: I was one of the first in the lobby for {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the arena's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a sold-out show!
Hardly anyone's watching {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the stands!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the series. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding behind the monitor. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody grab the mouse!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My hands are shaking. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This final's gonna be loud!
Pixel-thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A bad fight, not a lost series! Come help it recover!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't out. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me carry this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Total wipe. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs every sub on the bench, fast!
{pick} is getting stomped by {other}. Rescue squad, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me hold the lead.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the lead slip!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a keycap!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the highlight reel, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Grab a seat before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the flank coming.
